text:
Alex: noticed weird P99 jumps in the latency dashboard for /v1/generate after the routing weight tweak earlier today. p50 stable but p95/p99 diverge per endpoint.
Maya: same. p50 looks fine, p95 up ~30ms on eu-1 variants, p99 up ~200ms. sample_count for those slices is low-ish but not zero.
Lee: could be sampling artifact. Are we computing percentiles over sampled rows without applying sample weights? iirc our query does `quantile(0.99, latency)` on sampled feeds.
Noah: yep that's the hypothesis. When fallback routing hits CPU pool we see different request size distribution -> heavier tails -> sampling amplifies this.
Alex: here's the current query we use in the UI: ```SELECT endpoint, quantile(0.99, latency_ms) as p99, count() as sample_count FROM latency_samples WHERE window=5m GROUP BY endpoint;``` no weighting.
Maya: I'd rather add an explicit sample_count badge next to percentiles before changing aggregation semantics. makes the UX explicit.
Sam: can we quickly validate by re-running the backend rollup with weighted quantiles (by sample_weight) on the suspect window and compare? small job.
Lee: quick shell to sanity-check counts: `curl -s "$CONSOLE_QUERY?query=count_over_time(latency_samples{endpoint='/v1/generate'}[5m])"`
Noah: also consider annotating the route that changed weights in the rollout timeline so console shows "routing policy changed at t=..." — that would help correlate.
Alex: agreed. proposal: 1) add small "samples: N" next to p50/p95/p99, 2) tag any percentile that comes from sampled stream with a small tooltip "sampled", 3) run a one-off weighted quantile job and post diffs in thread.
Maya: +1. low-risk UX change and makes dashboards self-explanatory.
CI Bot: deploy started: console-ui/rollout v2.14.3 -> canary (by Sam) :rocket:
Sam: I'll run the weighted-quantile job now and paste a diff.
Noah: if weighted quantiles fix it we should also check the aggregator contract (sampled vs full ingestion) before we change the default calculation.
Alex: thanks. Sam, can you post the diff and sample_counts here when done? we'll decide if we need a short-term tooltip-only fix vs backend change.
Sam: will report in ~10m :eyes:
